## Dhole (CR 25)

**XP** 1,638,400  
CN Colossal magical beast  
**Init** +3; **Senses** blindsense 6 miles, tremorsense 600 ft.; Perception +46  

**Defense**

 **AC** 43, touch 1, flat-footed 43 (–1 Dex, +42  natural, –8 size)  
**hp** 748 (34d10+408)  
**Fort** +32, **Ref** +20, **Will** +22  
**Defensive Abilities** blind, compression; **DR** 15/—; **Immune** acid, cold, fire, gaze weapons, magical control, paralysis, poison, sight-based attacks, sleep, stun; **SR** 36  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 100 ft., burrow 100 ft.  
**Melee** bite +47 (8d6+30/19–20 plus grab), slam +46 (8d8+30/19–20 plus grab)  
**Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 90 ft.  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon, constrict (10d6+30), devastation, overwhelming strength, swallow whole (20d6 bludgeoning damage and 20d10 acid damage, AC 31, 56 hp), trample (10d8, DC 47), tremor  

**Tactics**

 Dholes are unfazed by extreme temperatures and are not harmed by the strongest poisons or acid. They can burrow through the earth at an incredible speed, creating an environmental hazard as much as presenting a combat challenge. They prefer to spit on smaller foes from miles away or simply roll over them, reserving bites and grappling for enemies of comparable size to themselves.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 50, **Dex** 8, **Con** 32, **Int** 3, **Wis** 29, **Cha** 27  
**Base Atk** +34; **CMB** +62 (+66 bull rush, +64 sunder); **CMD** 71 (73 vs. bull rush, 73 vs. sunder, can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Critical Focus, Great Fortitude, Greater Bull Rush, [Powerful Maneuvers](../../rules/feats/powerful-maneuvers.md), Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (slam), Improved Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Staggering Critical, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Improved Bull Rush, Improved Sunder are covered by Powerful Maneuvers; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Toughness.*  
**Skills** Perception +46  
**Languages** Aklo (rarely speaks)  
**SQ** massive  

**Special Abilities**

 **Blind (Ex)** A dhole is blind, and senses through its tremorsense ability and its incredible blindsense (although it generally only needs to use the latter to target its breath weapon). It is invulnerable to all sight-based effects and attacks, including gaze attacks.  

 **Breath Weapon (Su)** Once every minute, a dhole can expel a prodigious amount of thick acidic slime from its gullet. This breath weapon has a range of 6 miles, and creates an 80-foot-diameter spread of slime in its targeted area. A creature within this area must make a successful DC 38 Reflex save or take 20d10 points of acid damage. A successful save reduces the damage to 10d10.
